steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: Schwarz, the years I spent studying in Victoria weren't just for show.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: There, I studied the most cutting-edge science and technology pertaining to Catastrophe and Originium research.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: Things that seem to fall within the realm of the divine to you, may well be a fact of reality for me.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: Everything that I've learned, as well as everything I believe in, tells me that I am right.

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: Milady, you did not go to law school.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: Huh...?

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: What is Rhodes Island trying to do at the City Hall?

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: Searching for evidence to use against Cronin.

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: Hmm?

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: Cronin may be slimy, but he's not stupid.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: He's a Catastrophe Messenger. There's no way he doesn't know about the volcano's situation.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: I'm sure he's hiding the truth for his own benefit, and as long as we can gather the evidence secretly...

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: I think Rhodes Island will confront him directly, so that whole secret search is unlikely to succeed.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: It-it's fine! Since you're not there...

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: Milady, I want to know why you're doing this. If you give me a reasonable answer, I won't go after Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: ...This is something I have to do. I don't believe that my father is such a cold-blooded person. He would never stand by idly and let this happen.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: My father loves this city more than anyone else. And I know that better than anyone else.

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: Do you still hate him?

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: Why would I? If anything, he should be the one who hates me, because my birth took my mother's life...

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: But he never resented me.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: What I hate is how he arranges everything for me and never tells me what he's planning.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: It may seem like he's protecting me, but the end result is that I only end up ignorant and helpless.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: Just like right now! It must be Cronin's fault; he must have hidden the truth about the eruption from my father.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: That's the only reason he ordered Cronin to stop me! Would you call that hate?

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: Eruption?

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: What Cronin said was, you were going to reveal Master Doykos's secrets, so that he would be dismissed and put on trial.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: What?! No, what did my father even do in the past?

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: Don't worry about it.

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: ...Hmm, I see what is going on now.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: So Cronin wasn't even under my father's orders when he tried to capture me. Phew, that about clears things up.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: Schwarz, if I really wanted to do something like that, I would have gone through legal channels.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: Everything that I'm doing is also for the sake of this city, my hometown.

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: I understand. Milady, you're not concerned about the past, or about social standings.

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: I feel the same way as you. As does your father.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: Phew... No matter what others think, I'll always trust you and my father.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: Even if there's a conflict between our goals, I trust that we'll be able to resolve things between the two of us.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: That's why I believed that you'd be here. We both understand this city well.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: That's why you'd come to stop me.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: Come to think of it, it doesn't really matter who the mayor is, right? I'm sure that's what my father would think. What he cares about is this city.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: That's why I know he'll agree with me.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: Schwarz... wouldn't you agree?

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: You've grown, milady.
